name: Sin-Stained Spear
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG, enjoy a 300% {STR} bonus. {Turn Unique}: Gain 1 stack of {Undertow}.
lore:
When a knight takes his oath, the steel at his side is likewise gilded in glory.
But his first silver spear, entrusted with a sacred mission, had long ago melted in the embers of war.
Since he was a sinner already, he might as well let this wicked black slime serve as his new weapon. That way, he thought, even if it took on more blood, it would bring no further shame upon those now gone.
